room1.name: The Keypad
room1.description: A dimly lit server room. A heavy steel door bars your exit. The PIN is hidden somewhere in the room.
room1.atmosphere: Server humming. Dust on every surface. One red light blinks.

room2.name: The Cipher Wheel
room2.description: A dusty library. An ancient mechanical wheel sits on a pedestal.
room2.atmosphere: Wax drips. Pages rustle. Something is encoded here.
room2.clueText: A grandfather clock is frozen at 5:00 PM. A dusty mirror hangs beside it.

room3.name: The Fuse Box
room3.description: A utility room reeking of ozone. The circuit board on the wall is a scrambled mess of wires.
room3.atmosphere: Sparks crackle. The lights flicker. Patch the circuit.
room3.clue1: 1. The wire connected to HIGH is neither Blue nor Red.
room3.clue2: 2. The Red wire connects exactly one level above the Yellow wire.
room3.clue3: 3. The ALT post is not connected to the Green wire.
room3.clue4: 4. The Yellow wire connects to a post lower than the Blue wire's post.

escape.hall_of_fame_subtitle: Players who escaped at least one room, ranked by rooms cleared.
escape.no_one_escaped: No one has escaped any rooms yet. Be the first!
escape.ui_cipher_instruction: This is a Caesar cipher. By dragging the wheel, you shift every letter in the encoded message by a fixed number of spaces across the alphabet.
escape.ui_cipher_wheel_aria: Cipher shift wheel — drag left or right
escape.ui_connect_wires: Connect each wire to its matching post. Tap the wire, then tap the post.
escape.ui_escape_subtitle: Solve the puzzles. Open the doors. Get out.

room4.name: The Sphinx's Sanctum
room4.description: A massive stone chamber filled with sand. A monolithic statue with human head and lion body stares at you.
room4.atmosphere: Sand shifts beneath your feet. Two glowing eyes watch from the dark.
room4.riddleText:
I guard a secret,
yet have no voice.
Turn me right,
and I reveal your choice.

room5.name: The Memory Matrix
room5.description: A stark white room with a 3x3 terminal. You must prove your memory to pass.
room5.atmosphere: Neon lights pulse. A mechanical voice demands sequences.
